lines.name: DIAVLOWAV
lines.claim: A local audio workstation for Windows
lines.summary: A local audio workstation for Windows: stem separation, mastering, audio-to-MIDI and a model browser that rates every model against your hardware. Processing is local by default, and every figure in the interface is measured, never estimated.
lines.edge: Releases are built in CI, checksummed and signed; the app refuses an update whose signature does not match.

lines.name: DIAVLO MIND
lines.claim: A working method for AI agents, with a benchmark
lines.summary: A working method for AI agents, packaged as an Agent Skill, a Claude Code plugin with eight subagents and four portable system prompts. It makes a model write down the requirements, pick an effort level, test what it built and report with evidence.
lines.edge: It ships with the benchmark that measures what it changes, including the runs where it changed nothing.

lines.name: DIAVLO PLAYER
lines.claim: A native audio player for Windows
lines.summary: A native audio player for Windows with a frameless glass window. Open it, drop a file on it, listen: WAV, FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, Opus, AIFF and M4A, from the desktop or the command line.

lines.name: DIAVLO DROP
lines.claim: One beat in, a full release package out
lines.summary: One finished beat in, a complete release package out: masters and tagged previews, cover art, visualizer videos for every aspect ratio and ready-to-paste metadata.
lines.edge: Described in its README; no public build has been released yet.
